title: Redesign UI/UX with clean minimal design and remove false face detection warnings

requirements.summary: Redesign overall UI layout with minimal, modern design using better spacing, consistent typography, soft colors, and structured grid system with card-based sections
acceptanceCriteria: All components use consistent spacing scale and typography
Card-based sections have rounded corners and subtle shadows
Grid layout system applied for structured content arrangement
Soft color palette used throughout the interface
Visual clutter reduced with cleaner component designs

file_operations.description: Update global styles to implement a consistent design system with improved spacing scale (using rem units for 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px), refined typography with font-size scale and line-height values, and softer color palette in CSS variables for both light and dark themes. Add utility classes for card shadows, rounded corners, and grid layouts.

Extend Tailwind configuration to include custom spacing scale, typography settings, border radius values for cards (rounded-lg, rounded-xl), box-shadow utilities for subtle card shadows, and grid column/gap configurations for structured layouts. Ensure theme colors align with the minimal, soft color palette.

Redesign header component with cleaner layout, improved spacing using the new design system, refined typography for branding, and card-based styling with subtle shadow. Apply minimal design aesthetic while maintaining navigation functionality.
Update footer with minimal design, improved spacing, and refined typography consistent with the new design system. Reduce visual clutter while maintaining attribution.

Redesign dashboard layout with grid system for organized sections, card-based containers with rounded corners and subtle shadows, improved spacing between elements, and refined typography hierarchy. Apply soft color palette and ensure visual consistency with the minimal design approach.

Apply minimal design approach with card-based layout, improved spacing, refined typography, and soft colors. Use grid system for organized timer controls and statistics display. Add rounded corners and subtle shadows to card sections.

Redesign camera monitor with card-based layout, refined status indicators using consistent spacing and typography, soft colors for status badges, and minimal visual style. Apply rounded corners and subtle shadows to the container.
Update goal setting card with improved spacing, refined typography, soft colors, and minimal design aesthetic. Ensure consistent card styling with rounded corners and subtle shadows.
Redesign motivational quote card with cleaner layout, improved spacing, refined typography, and soft color palette. Apply consistent card styling with rounded corners and subtle shadows.

Update chart styling with soft colors, refined typography for labels and tooltips, improved spacing, and minimal design aesthetic. Ensure chart integrates seamlessly with the card-based layout system.

requirements.summary: Reduce visual clutter by removing unnecessary text, alerts, and always-visible elements to create a calm, focused study environment
acceptanceCriteria: Unnecessary text and redundant labels removed
Non-essential alerts and warnings minimized
Interface maintains calm, minimal aesthetic
Only essential information displayed during study sessions

file_operations.description: Remove verbose status text and redundant labels from camera monitoring interface. Keep only essential status indicators with icons and minimal text. Simplify the display to reduce visual noise while maintaining critical information visibility.

Remove unnecessary instructional text, redundant labels, and verbose messages. Keep interface minimal with essential timer information, controls, and statistics. Simplify session information display to reduce visual clutter.

Remove redundant explanatory text and verbose labels. Streamline statistics display to show only essential metrics with clear visual hierarchy. Eliminate unnecessary instructional messages while maintaining data clarity.
Simplify warning messages to be concise and non-intrusive. Remove verbose explanatory text while maintaining clear communication of the distraction type and necessary action.
Streamline site blocking alert to be minimal and clear. Remove unnecessary text while keeping essential information about blocked sites and session time.
Simplify music player interface by removing verbose labels and redundant text. Keep controls minimal and intuitive with icons and essential labels only.

requirements.summary: Create strong hero section on homepage with prominent headline, FocusGuard tagline, and clear 'Start Focus Session' CTA button navigating to timer page
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section prominently displays FocusGuard headline
Tagline 'Stay Present. Stay Disciplined. Stay Ahead.' visible in hero
'Start Focus Session' button clearly visible and functional
Hero section creates strong visual impact as landing point

file_operations.description: Create new homepage component with a strong hero section featuring the FocusGuard headline, tagline 'Stay Present. Stay Disciplined. Stay Ahead.', and a prominent 'Start Focus Session' button that navigates to /timer. Use the generated hero image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-study.dim_1200x600.png as a background or decorative element. Apply card-based layout with rounded corners, subtle shadows, and the minimal design system.

Add route configuration for the new HomePage component at path '/' (root). Ensure the hero section with 'Start Focus Session' button is the landing page and properly wired into the router. Update navigation structure to include the homepage route.
Add navigation link to the homepage (/) in the header navigation menu. Ensure header provides clear navigation between Home, Timer, and Dashboard pages.

requirements.summary: Add feature cards to homepage showcasing Camera Monitoring, Focus Music, App Blocking, and Study Stats with icons, titles, and descriptions in clean card layout
acceptanceCriteria: Four feature cards displayed in grid layout
Each card shows Camera Monitoring, Focus Music, App Blocking, or Study Stats
Cards include icons, titles, and concise descriptions
Cards use consistent styling with rounded corners and shadows

file_operations.description: Add a features section below the hero with four feature cards in a responsive grid layout (2x2 on desktop, single column on mobile). Each card represents: Camera Monitoring (with icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-camera-active.dim_48x48.png), Focus Music, App Blocking, and Study Stats (with icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-streak.dim_64x64.png). Include concise title and description for each feature. Apply card-based styling with rounded corners, subtle shadows, consistent spacing, and soft colors.

Create reusable FeatureCard component that accepts props for icon, title, and description. Apply consistent card styling with rounded corners, subtle shadows, improved spacing, and refined typography following the minimal design system.

requirements.summary: Improve Dashboard component with cleaner layout, better visual hierarchy, improved spacing, and organized sections emphasizing key statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard layout improved with better spacing
Key statistics emphasized through visual hierarchy
Information organized in logical, scannable sections
Dashboard maintains minimal, uncluttered appearance

file_operations.description: Restructure dashboard layout with clear visual hierarchy: primary statistics in prominent card grid at top, secondary metrics in organized sections below. Use larger typography and visual weight for key stats (total study time, focus score, streak using icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-streak.dim_64x64.png). Improve spacing between sections using the design system scale. Organize information in scannable, logical groupings with card-based containers.

Enhance chart presentation with better visual hierarchy, improved spacing around chart elements, refined typography for axes and labels, and integration into the card-based layout system. Ensure chart emphasizes key data trends while maintaining minimal aesthetic.

requirements.summary: Implement comprehensive dark mode support with proper color theming maintaining readability and calm study environment aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode toggle available and functional
All components properly themed for dark mode
Dark mode color scheme maintains high readability
Theme preference persisted across sessions

file_operations.description: Create ThemeToggle component with a button to switch between light and dark modes. Use icons (sun/moon) for visual clarity. Apply minimal design with smooth transition. The component should use the existing ThemeProvider context to toggle themes.
Integrate ThemeToggle component into the header navigation, positioning it appropriately in the header layout. Ensure the toggle is accessible and visually consistent with the minimal design.

Enhance dark mode color variables to ensure comprehensive theming coverage. Define dark mode versions for all UI elements including cards, text, backgrounds, borders, and interactive states. Ensure high contrast and readability in dark mode while maintaining the calm, soft aesthetic.
Ensure all dashboard elements properly respond to theme changes. Verify card backgrounds, text colors, chart colors, and interactive elements display correctly in both light and dark modes.
Update timer component styling to properly support dark mode. Ensure timer display, controls, and statistics are readable and visually appealing in both themes.
Apply dark mode theming to camera monitor interface. Ensure video preview container, status indicators, and controls are properly styled for both light and dark themes.
Ensure homepage hero section and feature cards properly support dark mode theming. Verify background images, text, and card elements display correctly in both themes.

requirements.summary: Add smooth, subtle animations for transitions, state changes, and interactions that enhance UX without being distracting
acceptanceCriteria: Smooth transitions added for component state changes
Hover and click interactions include subtle animations
Animations are gentle and non-distracting
Animation duration and easing appropriate for study context

file_operations.description: Extend Tailwind animation configuration with custom animations for subtle UI interactions: fade-in, slide-in, scale-up, and pulse effects. Define easing functions (ease-in-out, ease-out) and duration values (150ms, 200ms, 300ms) appropriate for non-distracting study context.

Add global CSS transition classes and keyframe animations for smooth state changes. Define animations for card hover effects, button interactions, modal appearances, and alert transitions. Use subtle timing and easing to avoid distraction.
Add smooth fade-in animations for dashboard cards and statistics as they load. Apply subtle hover animations to interactive elements. Use gentle transitions for stat updates and tab changes.
Add smooth transitions for timer state changes (start, pause, complete). Apply subtle scale animations to control buttons on hover. Use gentle fade transitions for statistics updates.
Add smooth slide-in animation when warning appears and fade-out when dismissed. Ensure animation is noticeable but not jarring in the study context.
Add gentle fade-in and scale animation when cycle prompt modal appears. Apply subtle transitions to button hover states.
Add staggered fade-in animations for hero section elements and feature cards on page load. Apply subtle hover animations to feature cards and CTA button.
Add smooth transitions for navigation link hover states and active states. Apply subtle animations to theme toggle interaction.

requirements.summary: Remove 'Looking at the screen' warning from camera monitoring system in useFaceDetection and related components, keeping only face presence detection
acceptanceCriteria: 'Looking at the screen' warning no longer displayed
Gaze direction alerts removed from UI
Camera monitoring focuses only on face presence detection
No distracting warnings for minor head movements or looking away

file_operations.description: Remove gaze direction detection logic and related state. Focus detection only on face presence (whether a face is detected or not). Remove eye state tracking and gaze direction calculations. Simplify the hook to return only face detection status without gaze-related data.

Remove all UI elements displaying 'Looking at the screen' warnings or gaze direction status. Remove eye state indicators and gaze direction status badges. Display only face presence status (face detected or not detected) with minimal, non-intrusive indicators.
Remove any logic or UI handling for gaze direction warnings. Ensure distraction detection focuses only on face presence loss, phone detection, and seated position without gaze-related checks.
Remove distraction warning cases related to gaze direction or looking away. Keep only warnings for face-not-detected, phone detection, sleeping, and not-seated states.

requirements.summary: Ensure redesigned interface is fully responsive maintaining clean, minimal aesthetic on desktop and mobile with appropriate breakpoints and layout adjustments
acceptanceCriteria: Layout adapts properly to mobile screen sizes
Desktop layout uses available space effectively
Typography scales appropriately across breakpoints
Touch targets sized appropriately for mobile interaction
Minimal design maintained across all screen sizes

file_operations.description: Configure responsive breakpoints (sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px, xl: 1280px) and define responsive spacing, typography, and layout utilities. Set up responsive grid columns and gap values for mobile-first design.

Add responsive typography scale using clamp() for fluid font sizing across breakpoints. Define responsive spacing utilities and container queries for adaptive layouts. Ensure touch target minimum sizes (44x44px) for mobile.

Implement responsive layout for hero section (full-width on mobile, constrained on desktop) and feature cards (single column on mobile, 2x2 grid on tablet/desktop). Ensure typography scales appropriately and touch targets are adequate for mobile.

Apply responsive grid layout for statistics cards (single column on mobile, multi-column on desktop). Ensure charts scale properly on mobile devices. Adjust spacing and typography for different screen sizes while maintaining minimal aesthetic.

Implement responsive layout for timer display and controls (stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop). Ensure timer is readable and controls are easily tappable on mobile devices. Adjust spacing for different screen sizes.

Make camera preview responsive (full-width on mobile with appropriate aspect ratio, constrained width on desktop). Ensure status indicators and controls are appropriately sized for touch interaction on mobile.
Implement responsive navigation (hamburger menu on mobile, full navigation on desktop). Ensure logo and navigation elements scale appropriately and maintain minimal design across screen sizes.
Apply responsive layout to music player dialog (full-screen on mobile, modal on desktop). Ensure controls are appropriately sized for touch interaction on mobile devices.
